name: Frequent Flyer: A Long Distance Love Story
source:
After Emi moves into a new apartment after breaking up with her ex, she embarks on a solo vacation to Scotland, where she meets a bonnie lass named Isobel.

They fall hard and fast for each other, but Isobel is hiding secrets that will shake Emi to her very core... do you trust her?

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/807770/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
艾米和前男友分手后搬进新公寓，随后独自前往苏格兰度假，在那里遇见了漂亮姑娘伊莎贝尔。

两人迅速而深刻地坠入爱河，但伊莎贝尔隐藏着足以动摇艾米内心深处的秘密……你相信她吗？

[来源：[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/807770/]Steam[/url]]
